description: Na₃MgNi₂SbO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Sb and four O atoms. The Na-Sb bond length is 3.12 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.41 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.60 Å. Mg is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.12 Å. Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.09 Å. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na and four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.33 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgSb square pyramid, corners with six ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃MgSb square pyramid, and edges with four ONaMgNi₂Sb trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₃MgSb square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent ONa₂MgNiSb trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, two equivalent Ni, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONaMgNi₂Sb trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃MgSb square pyramids, corners with four ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four ONa₂MgNiSb trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂MgNiSb trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MgSb square pyramid, corners with seven ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONaMgNi₂Sb trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one ONa₃MgSb square pyramid.
